name: Sword The
overview: The Bible depicts the sword as a symbol of both divine judgment and human conflict, serving purposes ranging from protection to punishment. In Genesis, the flaming sword guards the entrance to Eden, illustrating God's holiness and the consequences of sin, while other passages recount its use in warfare and deliverance, such as the patriarchs wielding it to claim their inheritance. Leviticus highlights the sword as an instrument of God's covenantal discipline, bringing calamity upon disobedient Israel. These verses collectively reveal the sword's dual role as an agent of destruction and a reminder of God's sovereign authority over justice and peace.
